risk_summary: The excerpt provides meaningful quantitative disclosure, including an 11% sales decline, reduced operating income, a net loss, negative operating cash flow, and increased borrowings. Risk tone is moderately negative, reflecting recessionary demand, consumer pressure, restructuring needs, and elevated leverage, although management uses optimistic promotional language regarding products and future positioning. Extensive boilerplate risk disclaimers and subjective claims somewhat dilute the clarity of the underlying financial deterioration.
